def can_place_dominoes(n, k1, k2, w, b):
    white_cells = k1 + k2
    black_cells = 2 * n - white_cells
    
    white_dominoes = min(white_cells // 2, w)
    black_dominoes = min(black_cells // 2, b)
    
    return white_dominoes + black_dominoes == w + b

def main():
    t = int(input())
    results = []
    for _ in range(t):
        n, k1, k2 = map(int, input().split())
        w, b = map(int, input().split())
        results.append("YES" if can_place_dominoes(n, k1, k2, w, b) else "NO")
    print("\n".join(results))
